description: Build a robots.txt file from allow and disallow rules grouped by user agent, with an optional sitemap line. You can pass a preset ('allow' all, 'block' all, 'wordpress') or your own rules array. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/robots-txt-generator/

preset.description: Use a ready-made rule set instead of custom rules

rules.description: Custom rules, each an object with agent, directive and path

agent.description: User agent, default '*' for all crawlers

path.description: Path such as /private/ (blank disallow means allow everything)

sitemap.description: Optional sitemap URL for the Sitemap line

name: hopi_robots_txt_generator

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Robots.txt generator
